answer: Written in a one long clause plus a short one register, it stays short. What survives to the shale is a record of labour, not a list of addresses. Peer attestation only means something when the peers can check the work instead of the name. Work waits on the crystal until a stranger signs it off, and that signature becomes the vertex of the next round. The design leans on cross-signed proof-of-personhood, re-queued for a second panel, rewards vest against future work.
